map.危险场所：防爆与防护关系燃爆与进水风险: Hazardous locations: explosion-proof and protection relate to fire/explosion and water-ingress risk
map.逐项判定：防爆等级≤1 级、密封等级≤2 级、防护等级（IP）≤3 级；三项均满: Item-by-item: explosion-proof grade ≤ 1, seal grade ≤ 2, protection grade (IP) ≤ 3; all three satisfied = pass. Insufficient explosion-proof causes fire/explosion; insufficient seal/protection causes water ingress and moisture.
map.防爆等级 1 级（≤1 ✓）、密封等级 2 级（≤2 ✓）、防护 IP3 级（≤: Explosion-proof grade 1 (≤1 ✓), seal grade 2 (≤2 ✓), protection IP3 (≤3 ✓): all three pass → qualified. If protection drops to IP5 it fails, insufficient dust/water proofing.
map.为示例防爆分区/类别上限（如 Ex d IIC 之类），实际须按气体组别与温度组: It is an example upper limit for explosion-proof zone/category (e.g., Ex d IIC); actual selection must follow gas group and temperature class, per certificate and nameplate.
map.IP 等级怎么读？: How to read an IP grade?
map.IP 后两位分别表示防尘与防水等级（如 IP65 防尘6、防水5）；本例以≤3: The two digits after IP denote dust-proof and water-proof grades respectively (e.g., IP65 = dust 6, water 5); this example uses ≤3 as the upper limit — set by the use environment.
